id: title:haacked:raise flag evaluations ttl to 92 days

review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse migration and maintenance, specifically extending the Time-To-Live (TTL) for sharded_flag_evaluations and adjusting TTL recalculation settings.
review.reason: The observed change extends the TTL for sharded_flag_evaluations from 90 to 92 days and introduces the `materialize_ttl_recalculate_only` setting while removing and re-adding `ttl_only_drop_parts`. This is a substantive, bounded maintenance and configuration improvement for ClickHouse, ensuring that metadata for existing parts is recalculated correctly without rewriting columns. It
review.uncertainty: The exact operational benefit of extending the TTL by 2 days and the specific behavior of the new setting are not demonstrated by the code alone; this score assumes the change is a necessary or beneficial maintenance update rather than a potential configuration error or unnecessary change.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains 15 hunks across ClickHouse configuration, migration, and test snapshots. All hunks share the same change: extending the TTL for sharded_flag_evaluations from 90 to 92 days and adding the materialize_ttl_recalculate_only setting. No tier assignment is made here; score is assigned after reviewing the complete group.

observations.behavior: TTL extended from 90 to 92 days; added materialize_ttl_recalculate_only = 1; removed ttl_only_drop_parts = 1 and added it back with the new setting.
